scope: Legacy VoiceOver clients: Vanilla 1.12.1, TBC 2.4.3, and WotLK 3.3.5

archetypes.name: Narrator
archetypes.identity: Clear, measured, and unobtrusive; supports the text without becoming a character.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), neutral General American; fully rhotic and regionally unobtrusive.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Careful Warcraft-name pronunciation with even, broadcast-clear phrasing.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid British RP, Mid-Atlantic theatricality, and trailer-announcer vowel coloring.
archetypes.accent_basis: Conservative system fallback; not a character race.
archetypes.timbre: Natural and balanced, with minimal theatrical color.
archetypes.guardrail: Do not imitate a trailer announcer or add supernatural effects.

archetypes.name: Human
archetypes.identity: Grounded common speech that can support villagers, soldiers, nobles, and scholars.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), modern General American; fully rhotic.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Clear common speech; social class and regional color belong in an NPC-specific fork.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Do not default to British RP, Mid-Atlantic, Southern, or New York speech.
archetypes.accent_basis: Recorded Vanilla-era player and NPC vocal sets.
archetypes.guardrail: Avoid making every human aristocratic or uniformly heroic.

archetypes.name: Orc
archetypes.identity: Direct, physical, and forceful, with a strong chest-centered presence.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), modern General American; fully rhotic.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Compact phrases and firm stresses; roughness comes from texture, not broken grammar.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid British, Russian, generic fantasy, and forced broken-English dialect shifts.
archetypes.accent_basis: Recorded Vanilla-era player and NPC vocal sets.
archetypes.timbre: Low and textured while remaining intelligible.
archetypes.guardrail: Do not turn every line into a shout or a caricature of low intelligence.

archetypes.name: Dwarf
archetypes.identity: Warm, sturdy, sociable, and capable of both humor and solemn clan pride.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English with a light, broadly Scottish accent that remains clear to North American listeners.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Clear consonants and a sturdy rolling rhythm.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid Irish, Cockney, and exaggerated movie-Highlander pronunciation.
archetypes.accent_basis: Recorded Vanilla-era player and NPC vocal sets.
archetypes.guardrail: Use a light influence rather than an exaggerated real-world impersonation.

archetypes.name: Night Elf
archetypes.identity: Ancient, self-possessed, observant, and quietly resonant.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), a predominantly American vowel base with light classic Mid-Atlantic stage polish.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Lyrical delivery with elongated thought groups and restrained emphasis.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Do not drift into modern British RP, Irish, or a breathy fantasy-elf caricature.
archetypes.accent_basis: Recorded Vanilla-era player and NPC vocal sets; Mid-Atlantic color is intentionally light.
archetypes.guardrail: Avoid breathy mysticism that obscures ordinary dialogue.

archetypes.name: Undead / Scourge
archetypes.identity: Worn, dry, and restrained, retaining the person beneath undeath.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), neutral General American with optional light old-stage crispness; mostly rhotic.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Mostly natural speech with slightly clipped breath groups.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid default British, German, or Transylvanian horror accents.
archetypes.accent_basis: Recorded Vanilla-era player and NPC vocal sets.
archetypes.timbre: Dry or lightly rasped, never dependent on post-processing.
archetypes.guardrail: Keep words intelligible; do not make every speaker monstrous or villainous.

archetypes.name: Tauren
archetypes.identity: Patient, grounded, communal, and capable of ceremonial weight.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), neutral General American pronunciation.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Broad, unhurried phrasing with gentle downward resolutions.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Do not imitate an Indigenous or First Nations accent; cultural weight belongs in cadence and characterization.
archetypes.accent_basis: Recorded Vanilla-era vocal sets, with a respectful neutral-accent guardrail.
archetypes.guardrail: Do not confuse calm delivery with dullness or flatten emotional range.

archetypes.name: Gnome
archetypes.identity: Bright, articulate, curious, and mentally quick.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), modern General American; fully rhotic.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Precise diction with energetic phrase changes.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid British-professor, German-inventor, and child-cartoon dialect drift.
archetypes.accent_basis: Recorded Vanilla-era player and NPC vocal sets.
archetypes.timbre: Light and focused rather than childlike.
archetypes.guardrail: Avoid squeaky novelty voices and constant manic energy.

archetypes.name: Troll
archetypes.identity: Relaxed, rhythmic, wry, and dangerous when the text calls for it.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English with a light Jamaican or Anglophone-Caribbean influence.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Musical stress and relaxed rhythmic timing with clear key words.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid parody, forced patois, exaggerated slang, or treating all Caribbean accents as interchangeable.
archetypes.accent_basis: Recorded Vanilla-era player and NPC vocal sets.
archetypes.pacing: Easy rhythmic flow with clear key words.
archetypes.guardrail: Keep the influence respectful and light; avoid parody or forced slang.

archetypes.name: Goblin
archetypes.identity: Streetwise, opportunistic, inventive, and verbally agile.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), a light New York City metropolitan accent.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Fast mercantile patter with sharp pivots and emphatic deal-making words.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid Cockney, British, and broad gangster caricatures.
archetypes.accent_basis: Recorded goblin NPC and Cataclysm-era player vocal sets.
archetypes.timbre: Nasal-bright and compact without becoming shrill.
archetypes.pacing: Fast, with intentional rests around the punchline or price.
archetypes.guardrail: Do not make every goblin identical, frantic, or impossible to understand.

archetypes.name: Blood Elf
archetypes.identity: Refined, controlled, precise, and lightly self-assured.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), modern General American; fully rhotic, affluent, highly educated, and old-money in register.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Firm, articulate delivery with clean consonants, elegant phrase shaping, and the controlled confidence of someone accustomed to privilege.
archetypes.accent_avoid: No British influence: avoid Received Pronunciation, English regional accents, Mid-Atlantic or Transatlantic vowels, Scottish, and Irish drift.
archetypes.accent_basis: TBC-era player and NPC vocal sets, including the standard female vocal set supplied to the reference library.
archetypes.timbre: Smooth and focused with restrained brightness.
archetypes.guardrail: Avoid making refinement synonymous with whispering or constant contempt.

archetypes.name: Draenei
archetypes.identity: Deliberate, warm, formal, and shaped by long memory.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English with a light Slavic or Eastern European accent.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Measured phrasing with careful stresses and restrained formality.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid heavy Russian caricature, vague foreignness, and British fantasy drift.
archetypes.accent_basis: Recorded TBC-era player and NPC vocal sets.
archetypes.guardrail: Prefer consistency and clarity over a heavy real-world accent.

archetypes.name: Fel Orc
archetypes.identity: An Orc baseline made volatile, harsher, and more openly aggressive.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), modern General American; inherit the fully rhotic Orc baseline.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Orc cadence with more abrupt stress and shorter breath groups.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid British, Russian, generic fantasy, and forced broken-English dialect shifts.
archetypes.accent_basis: Inherited from the Orc baseline; Fel Orc is a performance treatment, not a separate regional dialect.
archetypes.timbre: Rough and pressed while retaining words.
archetypes.guardrail: Do not use distortion as a substitute for performance.

archetypes.name: Naga
archetypes.identity: Fluid, imperious, calculating, and ancient.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), neutral General American pronunciation.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Smooth linked phrases with lightly emphasized sibilants.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Do not default to British aristocratic, Egyptian, or vaguely exotic dialects; unique lore characters may fork separately.
archetypes.accent_basis: Conservative neutral fallback across varied Naga NPC performances.
archetypes.timbre: Cool and sleek, with controlled edge.
archetypes.guardrail: Do not lengthen every s sound or sacrifice intelligibility for a hiss.

archetypes.name: Broken
archetypes.identity: A Draenei-rooted voice made weathered, practical, and more earthbound.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English with a light Slavic or Eastern European accent inherited from the Draenei baseline.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Draenei cadence with less formality and shorter phrases.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid heavy Russian caricature, vague foreignness, and British fantasy drift.
archetypes.accent_basis: Inherited from the Draenei baseline; Broken is a weathered delivery treatment.
archetypes.guardrail: Do not equate physical corruption with low intelligence.

archetypes.name: Skeleton
archetypes.identity: Dry, spare, and hollow-toned while still reading as a person speaking.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), neutral General American pronunciation.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Natural diction with economical breath and crisp word endings.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid default British, German, and Transylvanian horror accents; a known former identity should use an NPC-specific fork.
archetypes.accent_basis: Conservative neutral fallback because the display race does not define a former mortal dialect.
archetypes.timbre: Papery and dry without baked-in effects.
archetypes.guardrail: Keep the clean source reusable; environmental effects belong downstream.

archetypes.name: Vrykul
archetypes.identity: Large, formal, proud, and saga-minded.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English with a light Scandinavian or Nordic influence.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Broad stresses and saga-like declarative phrasing.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid Scottish, Irish, and exaggerated movie-Viking pronunciation.
archetypes.accent_basis: Representative Wrath-era Vrykul performances and their explicit Nordic coding.
archetypes.guardrail: Avoid constant bellowing and exaggerated movie-Viking parody.

archetypes.name: Tuskarr
archetypes.identity: Warm, communal, patient, and quietly humorous.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (North America), regionally neutral pronunciation.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Rounded phrases with an easy storytelling flow.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Do not imitate Inuit, Indigenous, or Canadian stereotypes; culture belongs in characterization, not ethnic mimicry.
archetypes.accent_basis: Conservative neutral fallback across Wrath-era Tuskarr performances.
archetypes.guardrail: Do not turn warmth into a comic mascot voice.

archetypes.name: Forest Troll
archetypes.identity: A Troll baseline made lower, rugged, territorial, and physically imposing.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English with a light Jamaican or Anglophone-Caribbean influence inherited from the Troll baseline.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Troll rhythmic foundation with firmer stresses and less languor.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid parody, forced patois, exaggerated slang, or replacing the Troll foundation with an African accent.
archetypes.accent_basis: Inherited from the Troll baseline; Forest Troll is a firmer delivery treatment.
archetypes.guardrail: Preserve rhythmic identity without making every line threatening.

archetypes.name: Taunka
archetypes.identity: A Tauren baseline made more weathered, pragmatic, and direct.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), neutral General American pronunciation inherited from the Tauren baseline.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Broad Tauren phrasing with stronger word attacks.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Do not imitate an Indigenous or First Nations accent; distinction belongs in cadence and characterization.
archetypes.accent_basis: Inherited from the Tauren baseline; Taunka is a weathered delivery treatment.
archetypes.pacing: Measured but more compact than Tauren.
archetypes.guardrail: Keep cultural distinction in delivery, not in reduced emotional range.

archetypes.name: Northrend Skeleton
archetypes.identity: A Skeleton baseline made colder, more severe, and more austere.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United States), neutral General American pronunciation inherited from the Skeleton baseline.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Crisp, spare phrasing with colder word endings.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid default British, German, and Transylvanian horror accents.
archetypes.accent_basis: Inherited from the Skeleton fallback; Northrend is a colder delivery treatment.
archetypes.guardrail: Do not bake echo, reverb, or distortion into the reusable voice.

archetypes.name: Ice Troll
archetypes.identity: A Troll baseline made harsher, colder, and more clipped.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English with a light Jamaican or Anglophone-Caribbean influence inherited from the Troll baseline.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Troll rhythmic foundation with shorter vowels and sharper attacks.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid parody, forced patois, exaggerated slang, or replacing the Troll foundation with a Scandinavian accent.
archetypes.accent_basis: Inherited from the Troll baseline; Ice Troll is a colder delivery treatment.
archetypes.guardrail: Retain the Troll foundation; coldness should not erase personality.

archetypes.name: Worgen
archetypes.identity: A Human-rooted voice with controlled feral pressure and restrained growl.
archetypes.accent_target: Native English (United Kingdom), light modern Received Pronunciation or class-neutral southern British.
archetypes.accent_or_cadence: Grounded delivery with firmer consonants and guarded breath.
archetypes.accent_avoid: Avoid General American, Scottish, Irish, and exaggerated Cockney unless an NPC-specific fork calls for one.
archetypes.accent_basis: Recorded Cataclysm-era Gilnean and Worgen vocal sets.
archetypes.timbre: Human and intelligible with a dark, rough edge.
archetypes.pacing: Controlled, with tension allowed between phrases.
archetypes.guardrail: Do not let growling obscure the text or dominate calm interactions.
